tagline.en: A dashboard for Excalidraw drawings — folders, sharing and multi-user, over your own storage
tagline.pt: Painel para desenhos do Excalidraw — pastas, compartilhamento e multiusuário, no seu armazenamento

notes.en:
Open `http://<host-ip>:8016` or `https://excalidash.<your-tailnet>.ts.net` and
create the account.

### Signing in with Authentik

`AUTH_MODE=local` ships by default: accounts live in ExcaliDash. To use
[Authentik](../authentik) instead, set `AUTH_MODE=hybrid` (both) or
`oidc_enforced` (only Authentik) and fill `OIDC_ISSUER_URL`, `OIDC_CLIENT_ID`,
`OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` and `OIDC_REDIRECT_URI` in the `.env`.

### Update

Both images carry the same tag, and they are bumped together.

### Backup

It stops both, packs the data, the `.env` and the secrets, and starts them
again. The secrets matter here: restoring the database without the same
`JWT_SECRET` logs everyone out.
notes.pt:
Abra `http://<ip-do-host>:8016` ou `https://excalidash.<your-tailnet>.ts.net` e
crie a conta.

### Entrar pelo Authentik

O padrão é `AUTH_MODE=local`: as contas ficam no ExcaliDash. Para usar o
Authentik, ponha `AUTH_MODE=hybrid` (os dois)
ou `oidc_enforced` (só o Authentik) e preencha `OIDC_ISSUER_URL`,
`OIDC_CLIENT_ID`, `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` e `OIDC_REDIRECT_URI` no `.env`.

### Atualizar

As duas imagens usam a mesma tag, e sobem juntas.

### Backup

Para os dois, empacota os dados, o `.env` e os segredos, e religa. Os segredos
importam aqui: restaurar o banco sem o mesmo `JWT_SECRET` desloga todo mundo.

excalidash-jwt-secret.note: Signs the session token and the CSRF token. The backend generates its own and keeps it in the volume when unset, but then a restore onto another host logs everyone out — 32 bytes is the minimum it accepts.
